## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The revision abbreviation should be fixed so running deployments retain the identifier shown in history and completion output. Tests were read, not run.

## Changes
The pull request adds running-status output containing an abbreviated revision and an attempt number, with tests for the status prefix and attempt formatting.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/display.py:14 — correctness — Use the same revision width in running status — For revision `0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567`, `status(revision, 2)` displays `0123456`, while history and completion display `0123456789ab`. The seven-character slice contradicts the function’s documented promise to use history’s identifier. — Users see inconsistent deployment identifiers across lifecycle output, and revisions sharing seven leading characters become indistinguishable in running status. — Fix: Use `revision[:12]` and extend `test_running_status_contains_attempt` to verify the revision.
